top_signals.title: Gary Neville ups ante in media battle with Gary Lineker with launch of Overlap Daily
top_signals.summary: Gary Neville is increasing the frequency of The Overlap’s football talk shows to daily in the latest move in his battle for eyeballs with fellow player-turned-media mogul Gary Lineker. The Overlap Daily will launch on Friday and run every weekday thereafter, with a line-up that includes former players Steven Gerrard, Jamie Carragher and Jamie Redknapp [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Tokyo’s record streak of rain comes to an end
top_signals.summary: Friday's showers capped the city's longest stretch of rainy days since records began in 1886.
